source: Owner screenshot attached to the Codex conversation
interpretation: The GMU fault probe ran from the runtime report thread and descended into the firmware planner with 13,120 bytes of GPU frames on top of the report thread's own 3,408-byte frame and thread entry. The ESR is a level-3 translation fault on a write, and FAR is in the stack guard page just below the thread's kernel stack, so the thread's 16 KiB stack overflowed. v125 ran the same chain with only a few hundred bytes to spare; the v126 fault record pushed it over. No GMU or SMMU evidence was produced by this image.
